title: Evaluation of Cork Splint Materials Instead of Plaster Splint for Children
brief_summary: This is an evaluation of the functionality and added value of cork splint materials instead of a plaster splint for children (3-11 years old).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Fractures of the wrist, forearm, elbow, ankle, foot
* Distortions of the wrist, elbow, ankle
* Wounds without tendon injuries
